desc: Programmes have shapes, and the shape is evidence. A concealed effort needs a chartering authority, a programme element or contract vehicle to carry money, a security classification guide, a government programme manager of record, and a contractor with a facility clearance - and every one of those is a documented artifact in some system even when the subject matter is not. The AAWSAP contract file, released by DIA under FOIA, is the best-documented example on this board: a solicitation (HHM402-08-R-0211) issued in August 2008, a statement of work specifying advanced aerospace weapon system applications, a competitively awarded contract to Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies, annual modifications, and a body of thirty-eight Defense Intelligence Reference Documents as deliverables. That file demonstrates the mechanism working in the open; the board's argument is that the same mechanism, run inside an unacknowledged SAP, produces no file at all. In November 2009 OUSD(I) reviewed a request to convert the successor effort into a special access programme, which is the documented moment where a visible programme structure is considered for conversion into an invisible one. Scoring high on this domain means an entity chartered, managed or concealed a programme rather than merely worked on one.
